name: Lucious Duller
source:
Likes: The castle in the labyrinth
Dislikes: Lively places
Hobby: Taking a walk in the labyrinth
Skill: Dancing

"I will never let you go."

Caesar: My ancestor, the House of Baroque trapped him into the labyrinth.
Hundreds years have passed since then...
As a descendant of the House of Baroque, I am willing to do anything to help him get out of there.
Hopefully, he will consider me as his friend someday...
If I asked him now, he would definitely say "Heck no!"...
It takes time, I guess...

[Official in-game description]
